metadata.description: Six free mods for the Claude app and Claude Code: Amplify theme, Handoff, Jargon Buster, Load, Screen share mode and Team Board.

plugins.name: amplify-theme
plugins.description: Amplify: a navy, cyan and orange look for the Claude desktop and mobile apps that turns your work into a momentum game, plus an /amplify-focus switch.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Handoff: when a chat gets long, packs the goal, plan, files, skills, links and last reply into a handoff prompt, copies it, and offers a Pick up button in your next fresh chat. No AI, no tokens.

plugins.name: jargon-buster
plugins.description: Jargon Buster: type /jargon-buster and Claude re-explains its last reply in plain, beginner language, or answers one question you add, without redoing any work.

plugins.name: load-monitor
plugins.description: Load: a small band above the message box with live CPU, RAM and GPU bars for this Mac, and a warning that names the process when CPU spikes. No AI, no tokens. Type /load to show or hide it.

plugins.name: screen-share-mode
plugins.description: Screen share mode: type /screen-share before a call or recording and client names, emails, phone numbers and money amounts show as made-up stand-ins on screen (or grey bars, if you prefer). Claude still sees the real chat.

plugins.name: team-board
plugins.description: Team Board: a progress bar above the message box for the plan Claude is working through, and a side panel with a live card for every subagent: what it is doing, its tool calls, tokens and estimated cost.
